title: The Non-Pure Dual Exchange Property in Low Dimensions
summary: We investigate monomial ideals satisfying the non-pure dual exchange property, a notion introduced in connection with componentwise polymatroidal ideals. Our contributions are twofold. First, we show that in two variables, every integrally closed monomial ideal satisfies this property; as a consequence, we characterize polymatroidal ideals in two variables.
